When 6ix9ine got caught lacking in the gym outside of his hood and got his ahh whooped 👀🥊

6ix9ine, whose real name is Daniel Hernandez, is an American rapper who first rose to fame in late 2017 with his viral hit single “Gummo.” Known for his aggressive, aggressive delivery and hyper-energetic aggressive vocals, his image became instantly recognizable due to his rainbow-dyed hair, extensive facial tattoos, and colorful grills. He became a prominent figure in the SoundCloud rap era, releasing successful tracks like “Kooda,” “FEFE” (featuring Nicki Minaj), and “GOOBA.”

Beyond his music, his career has been heavily defined by controversy, internet trolling, and legal troubles. In 2018, he was arrested on federal racketeering and firearms charges related to his involvement with the Nine Trey Gangsters street gang. Facing decades in prison, he agreed to cooperate with federal prosecutors and testified against several former gang associates. His cooperation led to reduced sentencing, and he was released to home confinement in early 2020 due to asthma concerns during the COVID-19 pandemic. Since his release, he has continued to make music and maintain a highly polarizing presence on social media.
